title: ID0442705-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P2 170000122] error on the LEM DC meter
description:
Reported issue: There are customer complaints that the charging station does not charge, or only charges at a maximum of 50 kW, and the charging points are going into failure.In the backend, you can regularly see throughout the day that individual charging points are unavailable, and the error message disappears repeatedly.There are a huge number of errors listed in the system. I have attached this as an excerpt.
